evaluation.decision: Compare both fresh final-epoch arms and retained PR35 on the unchanged 666-front primary and 663-front historical diagnostic references. Report misses first, then extras/duplicates, empty scenes, zero/one/two-locatable-corner coverage and both-corner successes at 5/10 original pixels with misses retained in denominators. Inspect gained/lost identities. Conflicting rankings are inconclusive. The separately versioned current development review may be replayed as exploratory evidence only; report its own hash, counts and unresolved rows, and never substitute it silently. No threshold, seed or epoch search and no automatic promotion.

limits: The complete157-photo r6 review is preserved. R7 directly reviews seven photos prompted by six new screenshots and the old_000013 confirmation; unchanged photos inherit that earlier review.
Visible target material and actual lower-front turns govern annotations. Approximate user marks are checked against original pixels; hidden corners are not guessed.
Every held training photograph retains exact PR35 labels in both arms. Supported review edits on those photos are not treatment-only changes.
Original664-front training validation and the fixed666/663 scoring references remain unchanged. The separately versioned current development review is exploratory.
PR72 has been audited with fresh fixed-reference inference and does not support replacing PR35. The new supervision package is a hypothesis to test, not a demonstrated improvement.
No training or automatic model promotion is performed during annotation preparation. Reused development scenes do not establish unseen-session reliability.
